title: Writing Task 2 - University Education Value
description: IELTS Writing Task 2: Is a university degree still necessary for career success in the modern world?

stimuli.title: Task 2: The Value of a University Degree
stimuli.content:
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

Write about the following topic:

In the past, a university degree was considered essential for a successful career. Nowadays, many people argue that practical skills and experience are more important than academic qualifications. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

questionGroups.instruction: Write an essay giving your opinion on whether a university degree is still essential for career success.

questions.content: To what extent do you agree that practical skills and experience are more important than a university degree?

bandDescriptors.taskResponse: Clearly state a position and support it throughout with well-developed arguments
bandDescriptors.coherence: Organise arguments with clear topic sentences and logical progression between paragraphs
bandDescriptors.lexicalResource: Use education-specific vocabulary: vocational training, employability, graduate premium, credentials
bandDescriptors.grammaticalRange: Use complex structures including conditionals, comparatives, and concessive clauses

sampleIdeas: Many high-paying tech jobs value demonstrable skills and portfolios over degree certificates
University provides critical thinking, networking, and breadth of knowledge beyond job skills
Rising tuition costs and student debt challenge the return on investment of degrees
Professional fields like medicine, law, and engineering still require formal qualifications
